sample_unit: risks, benefits, and alternatives (RBA) consent documents

links.outcome: Readability grade level of chatbot-generated vs surgeon-generated consent information
links.effect: Mean readability grade level was 12.9 (SD 2.0) for chatbot RBAs vs 15.7 (SD 4.0) for surgeon RBAs (P = .10), both above typical patient reading levels.
links.quote: The mean (SD) readability score for the LLM-based chatbot RBAs was 12.9 (2.0) vs 15.7 (4.0) for surgeon-generated RBAs (P = .10).

screen.reason: Empirically evaluates the readability, accuracy, and completeness of ChatGPT-generated informed consent documentation compared to real surgeon-authored documentation, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
